description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5935014548247 COVER AND GUARD,ELE: Line 0001 Qty 37 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0071 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
